# iaas_microvm_images (Data Source)

Lists platform and account MicroVM images, with optional local filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iaas_microvm_images" "ready" {
  status = "ready"
}

output "microvm_image_ids" {
  value = [for image in data.iaas_microvm_images.ready.images : image.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Exact source kind: base, dockerfile, oci, or git.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive image-name substring.
- `status` (String) Exact image status.
